mapper.sql: select c.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_name, c.term_id, t.term_name, c.teacher_id, u.nick_name as teacher_name, c.class_id, cl.class_name, c.cover, c.intro, c.status, c.copy_from, c.publish_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time from edu_course c left join edu_term t on t.term_id = c.term_id left join edu_class cl on cl.class_id = c.class_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.teacher_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course (course_code, course_name, term_id, teacher_id, class_id, cover, intro, status, copy_from, publish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{termId}, #{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{cover}, #{intro}, #{status}, #{copyFrom}, #{publishTime}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update edu_course set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: select class_id from edu_course_class where course_id = #{courseId} order by id
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_course_exhibit (course_id, target_type, target_id, sort_no) values
(#{courseId}, #{it.targetType}, #{it.targetId}, #{it.sortNo})
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_task where course_id = #{courseId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from edu_course_resource where course_id = #{courseId}

select distinct r.title from edu_resource r where (r.status <> 0 or r.del_flag <> '0') and ( exists(select 1 from edu_course_resource cr where cr.course_id=#{courseId} and cr.resource_id=r.resource_id) or exists(select 1 from edu_task_resource tr join edu_task t on t.task_id=tr.task_id where t.course_id=#{courseId} and t.del_flag='0' and tr.resource_id=r.resource_id)) order by r.title
